summary: Interrupted updates finish faster and more safely.

fixes.title: Finishing an update only redoes what's missing
fixes.text: When an update that stopped part way is finished, only the parts left behind are moved. Work already done is not repeated.

fixes.title: Updates wait for a busy Azure
fixes.text: When Azure is still busy with a repeated request, the update now waits up to 5 minutes instead of stopping. Repeated requests are shown in the update's run log and summary.
